text:
Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
2:46 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/Ultra 5 chip. You don't need a gaming graphics card unless you'll train AI projects or build games.

What matters most:

RAM: 16 GB is the floor. 8 GB gets tight with a code editor, browser tabs and a few running apps.
Keyboard and screen: You'll look at both all day, so pick a good keyboard and a bright Full HD screen (14 or 15 inch).
Battery: Look for 8+ hours of real use if you work away from a plug.
Mac option: A discounted MacBook Air with an M-series chip can fit near this budget and lasts long on battery. Check current prices, since they move often.

I haven't checked today's prices. What kind of programming will you do: web and apps, or AI and games?
